compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: workflows/ scan + CI guard (regression-prevention)
- dd-6: unit tests pass

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] Test file exists
  Verify: test -f tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py
- [ ] Self-check sub-test plants 'bridge_state' in a tmp_path workflow file and confirms the matcher detects it (proves scanner mechanics)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py::test_scanner_detects_planted_violation
- [ ] Production scan asserts ZERO hits in the REAL repo's .github/workflows/ — and the test EXPLICITLY pins the scan root to repo_root/.github/workflows/ (not tmp_path), so a mis-pointed scan cannot silently pass
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py::test_real_workflows_have_zero_hits
- [ ] Scan-root parametrization assertion: the scan helper receives an absolute path equal to (repo_root / '.github' / 'workflows')
  Verify: grep -qE 'repo_root.*workflows|\.github/workflows' tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py
- [ ] Test scans all three retired tokens
  Verify: grep -q 'bridge_state' tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py && grep -q 'prev_snapshot' tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py && grep -q 'mapping.json' tests/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py

## Implementation Notes (plan-review F1 — self-check tautology fix)

The test has TWO orthogonal assertions:
1. **Mechanics self-check** (test_scanner_detects_planted_violation): plant 'bridge_state' string into a temp workflow file under tmp_path; run scanner against tmp_path; assert ≥1 hit. Proves the matcher itself works.
2. **Production scan** (test_real_workflows_have_zero_hits): explicitly pass `repo_root / '.github' / 'workflows'` as the scan root; assert 0 hits across all three retired tokens. The scan-root parametrization assertion (above) defends against the mis-pointed-scanner failure mode where mechanics pass but the real scan never ran on the real tree.

This dual-assertion shape catches:
- scanner regression (mechanics break) → caught by self-check
- production-scan mis-pointing → caught by scan-root assertion
- real workflows regression → caught by production assertion

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
